headline: US Private Sector Adds 86,000 Jobs in October, Exceeding Forecasts
summary: U.S. businesses added 86,000 jobs in October according to ADP, surpassing analyst expectations and following a revised 90,000 jobs created in September.
why: The ADP employment report serves as a key indicator for the U.S. labor market ahead of the official government jobs report, helping investors gauge economic momentum and Federal Reserve policy direction.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Better-than-expected private payroll growth signals underlying resilience in the US economy.
